sn19.17:1.1: idhāhaṃ āvuso gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ bhikkhuṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantaṃ
sn19.17:1.2: tassa saṅghāṭipi ādittā sampajjalitā sañjotibhūtā pattopi āditto sampajjalito sañjotibhūto kāyabandhanampi ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sañjotibhūtaṃ kāyopi āditto sampajjalito sañjotibhūto
sn19.17:1.4: eso bhikkhave bhikkhu kassapassa sammāsambuddhassa pāvacane pāpabhikkhu ahosi.
